## Definition and typical features 
These studies aim to synthesize the results of methods research addressing a specific methodological research question, including quantitative and qualitative questions.

## Boundaries to related purposes

## Typical approaches and corresponding examples 
[Qualitative synthesis of methods research](../approaches/12qualitative-synthesis.qmd): meta-ethnographic synthesis of studies assessing the reasons for non-retention in clinical trials;[@Skea2019exploring] Synthesis of studies assessing factors that impact on trial recruitment;[@Houghton2020factors] synthesis of studies assessing the reasons for non-retention in clinical trials.[@Skea2019exploring] 

[Quantitative synthesis of methods research](../approaches/13quantitative-synthesis.qmd): Meta-analysis of comparisons between machine learning and logistic regression for clinical prediction models;[@Christodoulou2019a] meta-analysis of meta-epidemiological studies assessing the impact of blinding in trials;[@Wang2024compelling] meta-analysis of randomised studies comparing blinded versus unblinded risk of bias assessment.[@Morissette2011blinded] 

[Informal approaches](../approaches/15informal.qmd): Overview of approaches for evaluating heterogeneous treatment effects[@Lipkovich2023overview]
